text:
Conflict card:

Input: an archive on tape with few_copies = true and embargo = true.

Rule A - Replicate archives that have too few copies - applies and calls for replicate.

Rule B - Quarantine embargoed archives - applies and calls for quarantine.

Incompatible actions: replicate vs quarantine cannot both be done for this input.

Which rule wins for this case?
cost_basis: all terminal provider usage, persisted from first request
